about: The pick mattock as the skeleton holds it, first and third person (Rock R1a, docs/gameplay/rock_r1_stones_boulders_design.md 11.2). Points, bounds: item block units of the pick mesh as AflStaticMeshItemClient draws it (meshes/pick_mattock.aflmesh.json + (0.5, 0.0442, 0.5); y up the handle, the head at the top, the pick to +z, the adze to -z; tools/build-pick-mattock-v1.mjs prints them). Scale 1: 0.91 m handle, as the real 5 lb pick mattock. Held two-handed: the right hand at grip (the end of the handle), the left at grip_mid, up the handle, sliding down to grip_close (next to the right) for the swing; grip_high is kept for a short chop near the head (not used by R1a); tip is the pick's point (it strikes the rock), edge the adze's edge, eye the middle of the head.
